This can make timely access to a GP quite challenging for some patients. But we also have to remember that this practice serves a geographically large area with an increasingly elderly population catchment and hence there is a complex and labour-intensive case-mix. As well, the practice is of course financially limited (and by no fault of its own) by virtue of the simple fact it is entirely publically funded. Nevertheless, Hillsborough Medical Practice has some very experienced family doctors, such as GP partners Drs Hall, Winter and Crawford. They are also innovative in trying to adapt their practice services to meet increasing demands, yet they are never compromising in the high standard of empathic medical care which they provide to their patients.
